ValidationRule.description: UOM of term type product must have a term dimension.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Ruby__PriceModel__c, 'Recurring'), ISPICKVAL(Ruby__PriceModel__c, 'Usage'), ISPICKVAL(Ruby__PriceModel__c, 'CRBD') ), OR( ISNULL(Ruby__DefaultUom__c), ISNULL(Ruby__DefaultUom__r.Ruby__TermDimension__c), ISBLANK(TRIM(Ruby__DefaultUom__r.Ruby__TermDimension__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The UOM must have a term dimension.
